bodyPatterns.overflowAssessment: No explicit fixed-width body widgets. relatedSelection.method: Executed current selectRelatedNews against local records. Shared-tag score then descending dates; untaged stories fall back to recency.

checks.execution: Read-only Node/MDX/AST diagnostics with installed local dependencies; no test suite/full build/restart/network or application submission during this assignment.

retainedPurpose.detail: Single editorial title and description, byline/publication context, complete authored article, relevant next stories, optional newsletter.
retainedPurpose.archive: Chronological discovery with a single lead, all earlier stories, and feed/newsletter choices.
retainedPurpose.related: Three relevant links with date/title/description; shared artwork is intentionally repeated brand identity, not independent visual evidence.
retainedPurpose.body: No duplicate H1 or unsupported custom visual content warrants bulk body rewrites.

findings.title: Future-dated news is emitted by static routes, archive and related selection
findings.currentImpact: None of the 37 current stories is future dated. This is a future-publication policy gap, not a current leak.
findings.reproduction: Append an in-memory publishedAt=2999-01-01 story to getCollection fixtures: actual static-path declaration emits it, archive promotes it to latest, untagged related selection returns it.
findings.correction: If publishedAt gates release, apply the same finite-date <= build-time eligibility to all three surfaces and metadata inputs; do not add imaginary draft semantics to this schema.
findings.falsification: A future fixture is absent from paths, archive/list metadata, and related results; all 37 current URLs remain eligible.

findings.title: June 1 digest skips H2
findings.correction: Promote the four peer digest section headings from H3 to H2; preserve text and destinations.
findings.falsification: Outline contains one page H1 followed by four peer H2s; no fabricated parent section or duplicated title.

findings.title: NewsArticle speakable selector no longer matches the shared header
findings.reproduction: JSON-LD uses .article-header h1, but ArticleHeader now uses doc.hero and no article-header class.
findings.correction: Remove unsupported speakable metadata or use an intentional stable heading selector backed by an SSR assertion; avoid coupling JSON-LD to generated Panda class names.
findings.falsification: Every emitted speakable selector resolves to the intended heading in actual page HTML, or the field is omitted.

findings.title: Autolink word collisions point ordinary technical prose at unrelated products
findings.correction: Exclude ambiguous namespace/radius/fleet/waypoint from automatic matching and link genuine product mentions explicitly, or add equally narrow context-aware matching. Do not remove or create technology profiles.
findings.falsification: Run the real plugin on these seven bodies: ordinary concepts remain unlinked, explicit product links and unambiguous technology autolinks remain intact.

unusedComponent.reachability: No imports/call sites in content or website/src; no current news MDX imports or custom components.
unusedComponent.disposition: Unused library debt, not an active-page visual defect. Delete separately only after repository-wide ownership review, or migrate before reintroducing.
